content_of_post_to_comment: I had a crappy diagnosis, and getting treatment it doesn’t get me to the gym. I find when I’m in a routine of walking I’m okay but my health will take a slide and I’m off track with food and movement. I’ll gain weight quickly due to less movement and possibly trauma eating - need some support and experiences to get back into movement in a kind non punishing way
comment: The cycle of getting sick, losing your routine, and then feeling like you have to “start over” is such a hard trap. I’ve found that treating walks as the baseline instead of a workout helped because it kept movement connected to daily life, not punishment. Maybe rebuilding around tiny non-negotiables could make the dips less extreme.
